gap: No result ChatGPT got states the makers' phone floors: Apple Watch Series 12 / SE 3 require an iPhone 11 or later on iOS 27, Galaxy Watch8 requires Android 12 with 1.5 GB RAM and cannot pair to an iPhone at all, Pixel Watch 4 requires Android 11 with no iPhone support, and Samsung's ECG/blood-pressure features require a Galaxy phone, a user aged 22+, and a cuff recalibration every 28 days.
standout_why: Compared against the three cited pages. Wired (2026-09-29) lists compatibility only as 'iOS' / 'Android' and says Galaxy Watch9 ECG and sleep apnea are 'limited to Samsung phones only' and that only Android users can reply to texts on the Garmin Vivoactive 6. Tech Advisor (2026-10-27) says only 'Workout Buddy requires iPhone' and gives no OS versions. Android Authority (2026-01-07) never states a requirement at all. None gives the minimum iPhone model or iOS/Android version, the 1.5 GB RAM floor, the explicit 'iPhones aren't supported' line for Pixel Watch 4, the 22+ age gate on Samsung and Garmin ECG, or the 28-day cuff recalibration for Samsung blood pressure. The Samsung-phone-only ECG point is already partly in Wired, so this is new and useful rather than pick-deciding for most shoppers.
decides: Confirms ChatGPT's split (Apple for iPhone, Samsung/Pixel for Android, Garmin/Fitbit for either) but adds the hard exclusions: a shopper on an iPhone X/XS or older, or on iOS 26, cannot pair the Apple Watch Series 12 or SE 3 that ChatGPT recommended; an iPhone owner cannot use the Galaxy Watch8 or Pixel Watch 4 at all; an Android phone below Android 12 (Samsung) or Android 11 (Google) is excluded; and a non-Samsung Android owner buying the Galaxy Watch8 loses ECG, blood pressure and sleep coaching, which moves them toward the Pixel Watch 4 or Garmin Venu 4. Garmin's ECG is region-limited and 22+ only, so the Venu 4's 'works with both phones' advantage does not extend to ECG everywhere.

findings.label: Required phone
findings.value: iPhone 11 or later with iOS 27 or later
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch SE 3 require iPhone 11 or later with iOS 27 or later.' The Series 11 specs URL now serves the current-generation specs page. No Android support is listed.

findings.label: Required phone
findings.value: Android 12.0 or higher with at least 1.5 GB RAM; iOS not supported
findings.source_title: Discover what phones are compatible with your Samsung smartwatch (Samsung Canada support)
findings.note: Verbatim for Watch8/Watch8 Classic: 'Compatible with phones running Android 12.0 or higher and equipped with at least 1.5 GB of RAM' (same wording for non-Samsung Android). iOS: 'These watches rely on Google Play services, which are not supported on iOS.' Also: 'certain functionalities, such as Samsung Wallet, are exclusively available on Samsung phones.' Samsung Canada page; the US support site did not surface an equivalent page.

findings.label: ECG / blood pressure phone requirement
findings.value: Galaxy smartphone required; Android 12 or later, Wear OS 4.0; user must be 22+
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Ensure that your Galaxy Watch is paired via Bluetooth with the Galaxy smartphone.' Footnote: 'Compatible with Android 12 or later, Watch/Wear OS 4.0.' 'Note you must be at least 22 years old to use Samsung Health Monitor.' ECG 'not intended for users with known arrhythmias other than AFib or users under 22 years old.'

findings.label: Blood pressure calibration
findings.value: Third-party cuff, initial calibration then every 28 days
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Requires initial and periodic calibrations every 28 days using a third-party blood pressure cuff, sold separately.' Supported watches for BP: 'Galaxy Watch4 and later released Galaxy Watch. (excluding Galaxy Fit)'.

findings.label: Sleep coaching / Bedtime Guidance phone requirement
findings.value: Samsung Galaxy smartphone on Android 11+ for sleep coaching; Android 11+ with Samsung Health v6.30.2+ for Bedtime Guidance
findings.note: Footnotes: sleep coaching must be paired 'with Samsung Galaxy smartphones with Android OS 11 and above'; 'Bedtime Guidance is available on Android phones (Android 11 and above) and requires Samsung Health app (v6.30.2 or above)'; 'Galaxy Watch8 Series or later must be paired with a smartphone with Android 11.0 or above and minimum 1.5 gigabyte Memory.' Page lists 40 mm Bluetooth 'From $299.99 before trade-in'. The US page says Android 11 while the Samsung Canada compatibility page says Android 12; both agree on 1.5 GB RAM.

findings.label: Required phone
findings.value: Android 11.0 or newer; iPhones not supported
findings.source_title: Check Google Pixel Watch compatibility (Google Pixel Watch Help)
findings.note: Compatibility table row for Pixel Watch 4: 'Version 11.0 or newer'. Verbatim: 'iPhones aren't supported.' Google Health app section requires 'A Google Account and internet access' plus Android 11 or newer. No Pixel-phone requirement stated.

findings.label: Phone requirement for the Google Health (formerly Fitbit) app
findings.value: Android 14 or higher, or iOS 16.4 or higher
findings.source_title: Google Health app compatibility (Google product documentation)
findings.note: This is where fitbit.com's 'compatible devices' page now redirects. Verbatim: 'An Android phone with Android 14 or higher' and 'An iPhone with iOS 16.4 or higher'. The page gives app requirements, not per-watch requirements; Versa 4 and Inspire 3 do not appear in its 'Devices with compatibility issues' list.

findings.label: ECG app limits
findings.value: Select Garmin watches only; not available in all regions; adults 22+; Garmin Connect app on a compatible phone required
findings.source_title: ECG App | Health Science | Garmin Technology
findings.note: Read via a text-rendering proxy because the page is script-rendered. Verbatim: 'The ECG app is not available in all regions'; 'The ECG app is only intended for adults aged 22 years and over'; app is 'only available on select Garmin smartwatches'. The page's compatible-watch list did not render, so Venu 4 inclusion is not sourced from Garmin here.

findings.value: Wired: Galaxy Watch9 ECG and sleep apnea 'limited to Samsung phones only'; Garmin Vivoactive 6 'only Android users can respond to texts'. Tech Advisor: 'Workout Buddy requires iPhone'. Android Authority: no stated requirements.
